other_face_facts: Para 1: multi-million-dollar scheme to defraud the federal child nutrition program; qualitative, no dollar.
Para 91: more than 4.8 million meals claimed December 2020–November 2021.
United Youth: more than 1.3 million meals claimed (para 43).
Inspiring Youth: more than one million meals February–November 2021 (para 59).
Active Mind’s Youth: more than 500,000 meals February–June 2021; meal sheets alleged to claim exactly 2,016 children a day (paras 67, 71).
Aimee Bock is named as FOF founder/ED and appears in Count 15's wire (email to Bock) but is not a defendant in this instrument.
Mukhtar Mohamed Shariff / Afrique Hospitality Group and Farhiya Mohamud / Dua Supplies are named as third parties, not caption defendants.
June 1, 2021 $14,700 Active Mind’s Youth check (para 104) is a Count 21 overt act only; not a Count 22–37 row.

Do not add FOF $200M / $18M recitals or the Mohamed $12M to the Bock $250M charging headline without overlap_group_id (fof-network-scheme-size / mohamed-24cr015-family-receipts).
